description: Canonical Vercel project env vars that ops must know for LaxClaws staging/production. Contract test asserts every process.env.NAME referenced by listed surfaces appears here (and vice versa for vars tagged requiredSurface). Optional debug knobs are documented so empty-default behavior cannot silently drift.

vars.name: CRON_SECRET
vars.purpose: Bearer token for Vercel cron + staging-cron-scheduler curls of /api/cron/* and admin payout release
vars.whereCreated: Vercel project env (Production + Preview/staging); mirrored as STAGING_CRON_SECRET in GitHub Actions for the staging scheduler

vars.name: DAILY_DIGEST_WORKSPACE_IDS
vars.purpose: Optional debug override: comma-separated workspace ids for morning digest. Empty = full predicate (Telegram connected + heartbeat armed + ever-deployed + status not DRAFT/SETUP_INCOMPLETE/STOPPED). Override still applies the predicate — it is not a bypass.
vars.whereCreated: Vercel project env (optional). Staging trial may set the fixture id for focused soak; leave unset in production for full armed fan-out

vars.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_API_KEY
vars.purpose: Bearer token for Dodo Payments SDK (checkout, subscriptions, portal)
vars.whereCreated: Dodo dashboard → API keys; Vercel Production + Preview

vars.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_ENVIRONMENT
vars.purpose: Dodo SDK environment: test_mode or live_mode

vars.name: DODO_PAYMENTS_WEBHOOK_KEY
vars.whereCreated: Dodo dashboard → Webhooks; Vercel Production + Preview

vars.name: DODO_PRODUCT_PLATFORM
vars.purpose: Dodo product id for $79/mo Claw Platform subscription (claw_platform checkout)
vars.whereCreated: Dodo Products (subscription, $79/mo). Map id into Vercel Production + Preview. P7 live-product founder card if absent in live_mode

vars.name: DODO_PRODUCT_TEMPLATE_49
vars.purpose: Dodo product id for $49 one-time official templates

vars.name: DODO_PRODUCT_TEMPLATE_99
vars.purpose: Dodo product id for $99 one-time official templates
